messages.subject: Error in pmin(y, 0)
parts:
Dear all,

i guess this comparatively simple, but obviously I am sitting too long in front of that one.

I am trying to qplot the following:

qplot(variable,value,data=melted,geom="bar") + facet_grid(weight~.)

from some df that was created by melt() and looks like this:

weight variable value
1 unweighted gl 0.500000000
2 weighted gl 0.010309278
3 unweighted pr 1.000000000
4 weighted pr 0.017517392
5 unweighted none 0.500000000
6 weighted none 0.016343978

This should be straight forward, but somehow it does not work for me and all I get is the error message stated in the subject: Error in pmin(y, 0)
I have plotted quite a bit with ggplot2 and qplot, so I am sure it does work, and this particular dframe does work too as long as I leave out the "weight" variable.

thanks for any suggestions

best

matt

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: Error in pmin(y, 0)
parts:
Hi try adding stat="identity"

qplot(variable,value,data=melted,geom="bar", stat = "identity") + facet_grid(weight~.)
I think it should work then
Luciano
